The frozen live artifact proves only the initial toggler DOM. It does not capture the click request, response rows, count text, collapse label, loading state, focus, or failure behavior. This lane does not invent an Ajax contract or bind an inert local-only toggle.

Public fixtures place private revisions before public rows and separately saturate the exact 5000-row bound with private revisions. Saturation produces no partial Ajax body or initial snapshot; hidden rows never determine an exposed count or pager. Central Rust execution remains outstanding.
